onset.Description: Start of a stretch where the authors' cleaned grip-force trace (MOV_LEFT_CLEAN or MOV_RIGHT_CLEAN) is above 0, i.e. the first sample with value > 0 after a sample <= 0 (the first sample of the run for movement_ongoing_at_start_* rows).

duration.Description: Time until the trace returns to <= 0 (or the end of the run).

sample.Description: 0-based sample index of the onset at the run's 1000 Hz sampling rate.

Levels.movement_ongoing_at_start_left: MOV_LEFT_CLEAN is already > 0 at the first sample of the run (no onset inside the run)
Levels.movement_ongoing_at_start_right: MOV_RIGHT_CLEAN is already > 0 at the first sample of the run (no onset inside the run)

source_channel.Description: Channel the row was derived from.

peak_value.Description: Maximum of the trace within the stretch, in the release's units (not stated; see channels.tsv).

ends_at_recording_end.Description: yes if the trace is still > 0 at the last sample of the run.

Levels.yes: stretch cut by the end of the run
